  AGENDA

  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to
on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If
applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s office during normal business
hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make
inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be
made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours
prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however,
to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a
presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council shall
fill out a green speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits
the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific
agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City
Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of
items shown on the agenda.

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 6a-f)

All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion,
unless a Councilmember, staff, or member of the public requests that an item be removed for
separate discussion. An applicant or interested citizen who wishes to appeal any Planning
Commission decision (Item #6a-f) may file an appeal with the City Clerk’s office within 15
days after the date of the Planning Commission’s decision.

Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the
motion to approve the Consent Agenda.

1.  Waive Further Reading

  Recommendation: After the City Attorney has read the title, waive full reading of
  ordinances considered on this agenda for introduction on first reading or adoption
  on second reading.

2.  City Council Minutes of November 13, 2012

  Recommendation: Review and Approve.

3.  Adoption of Resolution R12-30 Approving a Budget Adjustment of $5,000 of COPS
  Funds; Approval of Funds for an Upgrade to the Police Department Dispatch Area

  Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution R12-
  30 authorizing the use of $5,000 in COPS funds to upgrade the Police Department
  dispatch area, and reserve the balance of $24,000 for future needs.

4.  Parklands Committee Meeting Items of November 12, 2012

  Recommendation: Review and Approve.

  a.  PC-351-12; Application to remove 1 Pine tree located in the parkway adjacent to
  4037 Via Pavion

  Applicant:  Eric Wong
  4037 Via Pavion

  Action: Approved (3-1, Peterson dissenting, Schoenheider absent). The applicant is
  approved to remove 1 pine tree located in the parkway adjacent to 4037 Via Pavion
  according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. A $500
  payment to the ‘Tree Bank’ is required.

  b.  PC-352-12; Application to reduce by trimming 2 Little Gem Magnolia trees located
  in the parkway adjacent to 569 Via Media

  Applicant:  Lorraine and Mike Norris
  576 Via Media
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

  Action: Approved (4-0). The applicant is approved to reduce by trimming 2 Little
  Gem Magnolias located in parkway adjacent to 569 Via Media to 11-feet and
  approve an annual no-fee permit to trim and maintain these 2 trees at 11-feet.

  c.  PC-353-12; Application to remove 1 Melaleuca tree located in the parkway adjacent
  to 1372 Via Coronel

  Applicant:  Stephanie Chen
  1372 Via Coronel
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

  Action: Approved (4-0). The applicant is approved to remove 1 Melaleuca tree
  located in the parkway adjacent to 1372 Via Coronel according to the ‘Standard
  Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. A $500 payment to the ‘Tree Bank’ is
  required.

5.  Traffic Safety Committee Meeting Item of November 14, 2012

  Recommendation: Review and Approve.

  a.  Request for edgeline striping and stopping restrictions on the west side of Via
  Olivera between Via Romero and 350 feet south of Via Romero

  Action:Recommended that staff: 1) install edgeline striping on the west side of Via
  Olivera between Via Romero and a point approximately 350 feet south of Via
  Romero to provide a pedestrian path; 2) install stopping prohibitions effective
  during the school morning arrival and afternoon dismissal periods on both sides of
  Via Olivera within this segment; and 3) bring the item back for review at the
  January 2013 Traffic Safety Committee meeting. (Approved 5-0)

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT
on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters
presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be
referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.

OLD BUSINESS

7.  Review of Via Del Monte Speed Survey Results

  Recommendation: This is a matter of Council discretion.

NEW BUSINESS

8.  Request to Amend the FY 2012 Palos Verdes Tennis Club Capital Budget for Emergency
  Sewer Project; Approval of the FY 2013 Operating and Capital Budgets, and Approval of
  Amendment to the Concession Agreement Increasing Non-Resident/Non-Owner
  Membership from 120 to 135

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
November 27, 2012
  5
   Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council amend the FY 2012
  Palos Verdes Tennis Club Capital Budget for emergency sewer project; approve the
  FY 2013 Operating and Capital Budgets; and amend the Concession Agreement to
  increase non-resident/non-owner membership from 120 to 135.

9.  Review of Parklands Committee's Recommended Rankings of Proposed City
  Enhancement Projects and Plan for Implementation

  Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Parklands
  Committee's rankings of proposed City Enhancement projects and plan for
  implementation.
